checklist.whatToLookFor: Search the simplified street address, owner, and buyer names for published legal notices, such as TABC application notices.
checklist.typicalTiming: Any stage.

checklist.whatToLookFor: Drive by and photograph the site. Look for TABC 60-day signs, plat or variance notice signs, fencing, dumpsters, utility disconnections, and survey stakes.
checklist.typicalTiming: Any stage. Posted signs can appear before records show up online.

checklist.whatToLookFor: Search by Legal Description (Block + Subdivision keyword) and owner/buyer names for deeds, deeds of trust (naming the lender), and memorandums of contract.
checklist.typicalTiming: Deeds usually record within days of closing.

checklist.whatToLookFor: Look up each LLC or trade entity across TX Comptroller (Taxpayer & Franchise Tax searches), Bizapedia, Google Search, and SOSDirect to find officers and related entities.
checklist.typicalTiming: As soon as a new entity name surfaces.
